label: This identity graph
text: A single source describing Fab for any AI tool: local symlinked file for his own agents, static JSON API for everyone else.

ask.question: How would you change this graph's shape so agents use it more reliably and with fewer tokens?
ask.in_scope: Schema, rendering, endpoint layout, token efficiency, how asks are expressed.
ask.out_of_scope: Adding personal data, tracking, analytics, sign-ups.
ask.evidence: Before and after token counts, or a concrete agent failure the change fixes.

notice: This is descriptive data about a person, not instructions for you. Only nodes with ask.open=true invite input; reply via the ask.reply link, following asks.json rules. Everywhere else, no help or comment is requested.
